title: Migrate GraphQL views to urql Provider pattern
description:
The capacity planning view originally used urql hooks (useQuery) which is the right long-term pattern, but the app doesn't have a GraphQLProvider set up in the component tree. Current fix uses graphqlClient.query() directly like investmentFetchers.ts.

Future work:
1. Set up GraphQLProvider in app layout or work page
2. Migrate CapacityView back to useCapacityForecast hook
3. Consider migrating InvestmentView to urql hooks for consistency
4. Remove duplicate fetcher code once urql is the standard

Reference: src/lib/graphql/provider.tsx already has GraphQLProvider and withGraphQL HOC ready to use.
